description: VYBE MUSIC v4.1.1 — Listen Together Real-Time Playback Synchronization with Beat Sync drift micro-adjustment, restored guest play/pause controls, latency-compensated joins, and stability enhancements.

changelog.title: Listen Together Real-Time Sync & Beat Sync
items: True local audio synchronization: host play, pause, resume, seek, and track change instantly sync and play on all room guests
Beat Sync: automatic micro-playback speed adjustment (1.03x / 0.97x) seamlessly eliminates drift without audio clicks or interruptions
Restored full Play/Pause controls in Player and Mini Player, removing confusing mute icon hijacking for guests
Initial Join & Reconnect Sync: guests immediately start playing at synchronized host timestamp with latency compensation
Participant control enabled by default with automatic 2-second host heartbeat synchronization

changelog.title: Recap & Social Sharing
items: Added high-resolution 1080x1920 (9:16) Story Image Export directly to Instagram Stories and WhatsApp with Google-themed card branding
Added automatic calendar seasonal themes (Winter Chill, Spring Groove, Summer Vybe, Autumn Warmth) with dynamic animated gradient palettes

changelog.title: Listen Together Upgrades
items: Live Floating Emoji Reactions: listeners can tap 🔥, ❤️, 👏, ⚡, 💃 to send real-time floating emoji reactions across all connected devices in the room

changelog.title: Player & System Polish
items: Smart Sleep Timer with gentle 30-second volume fade-out preventing sudden stops
Offline-ready badges tinted with primary dynamic theme accents
Background GitHub automatic update checker on launch with system notifications
Complete rebranding of all localized strings, widgets, and themes to VYBE Music

changelog.title: Playback & Network Resiliency
items: Resolved Playback failed IO_UNSPECIFIED (2000) with browser User-Agent headers and direct NewPipe stream fallback
Fixed mobile data infinite loading on Explore and Search with IPv4-prioritized DNS and safe caching
Extended connection and read timeouts for jitter-free cellular streaming
